Hi Samantha — welcome, and thanks for the form. Short answers up front, then a sample CSV row and acceptance rules below.

1) Channel preference: portal is preferred (supplierportal.redwood.com). It gives fastest ACKs and avoids manual triage. We will accept emailed invoices to billing@redwood.com during your first 30 days, provided you follow the exact subject/header and filename convention below.

2) Required headers/subject for email fallback: Subject must start with [PO: <Redwood-PO-#>] then your invoice number, e.g., "[PO: RWD-12345] INV-ACM-101". Include X-Accept-Token: HS-89012 in email body or as a header (this token ties the invoice to the activation record). If the header/token is missing, manual processing will delay payment.

3) PO stamping: Redwood requires the Redwood PO number on the invoice itself (visible in the top-right of the invoice PDF) OR on the first line of a CSV. Filename and subject alone are not sufficient unless the PO is clearly present in the invoice body.

4) CSV/line-item schema (we prefer a canonical CSV for high-volume partners):
Columns (required, in order): invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), PO_number, line_number, item_description, quantity, unit_price, currency, tax_amount, line_total
Sample CSV row (comma-separated):
"INV-ACM-101,2027-03-05,RWD-12345,1,Cloud compute (m5.large) 1000h,100,0.05,USD,50.00,5.00"

Notes:
- quantity and unit_price are numeric; unit_price is per-unit in USD.
- tax_amount is the tax for the line (we do not accept % in that column).
- For PDF invoices with line-items, ensure the PDF includes a matching summary with the same PO and totals.

5) VAT/tax and multi-entity: if you're billing from multiple legal entities, include the billing entity name and tax ID on the invoice header. For EU VAT, include VAT registration number on the invoice. If tax is withheld locally, flag in the invoice body and attach supporting paperwork.

6) ACK and SLAs: portal uploads get an immediate machine ACK. Email submissions will get an automated receipt within 24 hours if headers are correct; otherwise manual triage may take 3–5 business days. Payment terms remain per contract.

I've attached our redwood_invoice_template.csv (CSV stub with header row) and a short onboarding checklist. Use the sample row above as your canonical mapping.

If you want, we can run a one-off ingestion test next week — send a test CSV and a matching PDF and we'll validate the mapping, then toggle you to portal-only.

Best,
Kimberly Park
